facts.value: Accumulates the Maclaurin series for exp(abs(input)), starting from 1+abs(input) and adding power/factorial terms until exact f32 equality says the sum stopped changing. Negative inputs select the reciprocal. No iteration cap, overflow or nonfinite guard is present. NaN partial sums never satisfy the equality stop condition; termination is not guaranteed for nonfinite or overflowed intermediates.

facts.value: All seven f32 inputs flow through local arithmetic only. Let dx=x1-x0, dy=y0-y1 and c=x0*y1-y0*x1. facts.value: After the initial ratio passes, both endpoint distances strictly below threshold squared return zero. One strictly inside and the other outside or equal returns one.
